name: Musical Chairs
text: Before bidding, you may swap this sigil with the sigil on another one of your cards.

signature.target: this sigil and another card's sigil

decision: Whether to bring another card's sigil onto this card: worth it when this card suits that sigil better, such as a win payoff onto a sure winner.
opponent: Hidden until the card is played; one forced play against it hits the whole stack, which is fair counterplay.
rationale: One swap a round gives another engraving this sigil's placement, usually a face card, which is a few points at best, so it sits at common; it differs from Rearranged Desk (GY-C06), which moves a sigil to a card without one.
deviation: Revision 1: replaced moving any of your sigils onto this card (stacking), and moved from rare to common.
